notes.title: September Update
notes.content: [p]Hello again, travelers! Summer’s finally over, and it’s time to take a look at all those amazing photos you took during your trip.[/p][p][/p][p]We wonder if you’ve visited all the places and collected all the memories. Are these memories truly yours, or are you simply hoping they’ll be remembered as such?[/p][p][/p][p]So, about those memory puzzles, we get that some of you are up for a real brainteaser, while others might prefer a more relaxed session. To make it easier for everyone, we’ve added ‘Easy’ and ‘Hard’ modes when you replay the puzzles. And hey, who knows, maybe there were other cool routes you could’ve taken during your trip that might’ve helped you remember things better![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for playing Sunset Drive! If you enjoyed the game, we’d love it if you could leave us a review and give it a thumbs up. It’ll help us reach more people and spread the word. We hope to see you again on the road soon![/p]

notes.title: Late Summer Update
notes.content:
[p]Hello again, travelers! Going to have to take your ride to the pit stop for just a sec.[/p][p]Introducing skins to Sunset Drive! You will have access to two additional skins for your car immediately, with four more skins that can be unlocked simply by playing through the game.[/p][p]We have squashed several bugs, especially for the puzzle section of the game (thank you to all of you who reported them to us. Much appreciated!)[/p][p]Thank you, we hope to see you again real soon!
[/p]

notes.title: June Update
notes.content:
Two weeks have passed since our teeny tiny studio released our game on Steam. And, boy, oh boy, has it been an experience!

We are glad for the feedbacks y’all have given so far and so we tune things up back in the garage so the next trip will get better!

NEW:
- Background music to accompany you at detours.

Changes:
- Autosave will now be indicated at the beginning of every trip.
- Implementation of dialogue tracker! Previously selected dialog choices are now indicated with a checkmark to help players choose alternative answers.
- After the end of every trip, you will now be directed to the album menu to review visited places and see missed ones before returning to the main menu.
- Improved dialogues for better readability and fixed a bunch of grammar mistakes.

We’re looking forward to seeing how you all feel about these changes and hope you enjoy your next trip!

notes.title: Hello and welcome travelers
notes.content:
Hi ya, travelers! We’re so glad to have you with us. 

We want you all to know that we hear and appreciate your feedback on our game.
We intend to support this game for at least until the end of the year.

 So here are some of the things you can look forward to in the near future:
-          Dialogue improvement.
-          Music update.
-          Quality of life.
-          And more!

Stay tuned for our next update either here or on our socials!
